title: Polynomial of a subcircuit construction
statement: Let $C$ and $C'$ be arithmetic circuits on the same finite set of inputs, each with a nonempty gate list. The polynomial represented by the circuit formed from them using the specified shifted-node subtraction construction is the polynomial represented by $C$ minus the polynomial represented by $C'$.
